description: One moment in full, by its slug (from search results) or its realalpha.app/s/ link: the speaker and what they do, the show and date, their quote, the summary and takeaways, its topics, the big questions it answers and how, and the episode's other best minutes. Use it to read a moment closely before quoting it, or when someone shares a realalpha.app/s/ link.

slug.description: The moment's slug, like "ai-is-widening-the-gap-between-startups-and-incumbents", or its page's link

name: get_moment

answers.description: The big questions it answers, which way, and what the speaker says

cite.description: A line to credit it by

date.description: When the episode came out, YYYY-MM-DD

episode_url.description: The episode's page, from the moment on

quote.description: Their words, as said in the episode

speaker_page.description: Their page on realalpha.app, with every moment of theirs

starts_at.description: Where in the episode it starts, like 31:50

url.description: The moment's page, which plays the episode from it: the link to cite

title: Get one moment
